sources: Data Dragon 16.19.1 items.json (SR map 11 catalog shipped with RiftSense)

mechanics.name: Patch history
mechanics.value: Last balance change V26.09; no Warwick changes through 26.19 per patch history - values below are treated as current for 26.19

mechanics.name: Passive - Eternal Hunger
mechanics.value: Basic attacks deal 6-60.76 (by level) (+15% bonus AD) (+10% AP) bonus magic damage on-hit; below 50% max HP heals for 100% of that damage, increased to 250% below 25% max HP

mechanics.name: Q - Jaws of the Beast
mechanics.value: 80/85/90/95/100 mana, CD 8/7.5/7/6.5/6, 365 range; 6/7/8/9/10% of target max HP (+120% AD) (+100% AP) magic damage, capped vs monsters at 150/165/180/195/210 (+120% AD) (+100% AP); heals for 25/37.5/50/62.5/75% of post-mitigation damage

mechanics.name: Q hold and immunity
mechanics.value: Tapped: lunge and bite. Held: bite then 0.5 s charge and leap behind the target; Warwick is displacement-immune while Q is active and follows the target's movement. Can be interrupted by cast-inhibiting effects (silence); grounding/rooting prevents starting the held channel

mechanics.name: W - Blood Hunt
mechanics.value: 55 mana, CD 80/70/60/50/40; passive +70/80/90/100/110% attack speed for 1.25 s when damaging a target below 50% max HP (doubled below 25%); +35/42.5/50/57.5/65% MS while following a trail, lost 0.5 s on entering champion combat and rebuilding over 3.5 s; active marks the nearest enemy champion for 8 s regardless of current HP; CD reduced 30% if no champion is found

mechanics.name: E - Primal Howl
mechanics.value: 40 mana, CD 15/14/13/12/11; gain 35-55% damage reduction for up to 2.75 s; recast after 1 s (auto after duration) to fear nearby enemies for 1 s and slow 90% in a 375 radius; recast resets Warwick's basic attack timer

mechanics.name: R - Infinite Duress
mechanics.value: 100 mana, CD 110-70, 0.1 s cast; leaps with crowd-control immunity and stops on the first champion hit, suppressing them for up to 1.5 s; total 175-525 (+167% bonus AD) magic damage over the channel, healing 100% of post-mitigation damage dealt; applies on-hit effects and triggers on-attack effects 3 times; dash range scales with movement speed

mechanics.name: R counters
mechanics.value: A target that is CC-immune or spell-shielded when Warwick collides stops the channel from starting; Cleanse removes the suppression but does not stop the channel damage ticks

itemNotes.name: Blade of The Ruined King
itemNotes.note: 3200 g (SR catalog); on-hit % current HP damage; Q applies on-hit effects, so Q + BotRK is the health-stacking answer

itemNotes.name: Plated Steelcaps
itemNotes.note: 1200 g; 25 armor and incoming basic damage reduced by 10% (excludes turrets) - default boots into auto-attack-heavy comps

itemNotes.name: Thornmail
itemNotes.note: 2450 g; applies Grievous Wounds (40% reduced healing) - the anti-heal answer when the enemy team sustains through fights

itemNotes.name: Kaenic Rookern
itemNotes.note: 2900 g; 80 MR and a shield for 15% max HP after 15 s without taking magic damage - anti burst-magic

itemNotes.name: Sterak's Gage
itemNotes.note: 3200 g; burst shield when taking large damage - anti burst-AD third item when the enemy can lock Warwick down

itemNotes.name: Build plan source
itemNotes.note: Follow PLAN[Warwick] in build_intent.txt (Blade of The Ruined King -> Plated Steelcaps -> Thornmail -> Kaenic Rookern -> Sterak's Gage); propose a one-clause swap instead of rewriting the plan

decisionRules.rule: Max Q first; Q applies on-hit effects, so Blade of The Ruined King turns Q into a % max HP nuke against health stackers
preconditions: BotRK is owned or next in the plan

decisionRules.rule: Hold Q against mobile targets so the displacement immunity follows their dash or blink; tap Q when chasing a kill for the cooldown refund

Start ganks with W active: the active marks the target for 8 s regardless of health, and the trail movement speed rebuilds over 3.5 s after combat starts, so approach from fog rather than running in plain sight
preconditions: gank path is not already warded (unknown is fine, label it)

decisionRules.rule: Use E's 35-55% damage reduction before committing to a melee trade, then recast for the fear to lock the target for Q/R
preconditions: enemy burst is committed or you are diving

decisionRules.rule: Do not open with R into a spell shield or a CC-immune target; the channel will not start, wasting the 110-70 s cooldown
preconditions: enemy defensive cooldowns are observed or unknown (state as unknown)

decisionRules.rule: After R lands, R deals on-hit damage and heals 100% of the post-mitigation damage - R is the burst heal, so it is acceptable to R a front-liner to survive when the carries are unreachable
preconditions: Warwick is low HP and must stay alive

decisionRules.rule: Take Thornmail over a damage item when the enemy team has 2+ sustained healing sources; Grievous Wounds cuts healing 40%
preconditions: the fight is long enough for GW uptime

decisionRules.rule: Against burst magic take Kaenic Rookern; against sustained magic take Force of Nature or Spirit Visage; against burst AD take Sterak's Gage after core
preconditions: enemy damage profile can be classified

decisionRules.rule: Do not assume the passive heal saves you: Grievous Wounds (40%) and Ignite cut all self-healing, so back off while anti-heal is active
preconditions: Warwick is relying on Q/passive healing

counters.name: Grievous Wounds / Ignite
counters.note: Cuts Warwick's passive, Q and R healing by 40%; do not fight through it at low HP, and itemise Spirit Visage only after the anti-heal is answered

counters.name: Spell shields (e.g. Banshee's, Edge of Night)
counters.note: Block Q damage and prevent Infinite Duress from starting its channel; pop the shield with W/E first

counters.name: Kiting and grounding
counters.note: Grounding prevents starting the held Q channel; hard slows and knockbacks keep Warwick off the carry - hold E for the fear instead of chasing

counters.name: Cleanse / QSS
counters.note: Cleanse removes the R suppression but does not stop the damage ticks; the target still takes the full channel damage
